use_cases: Displaying status labels and metadata on product or content cards
Showing category tags and labels within horizontal scrolling carousels
Indicating feature flags or version badges in dev-tool interfaces
Creating visual hierarchy with semantic color variants in card layouts
Adding compact metadata indicators to list and grid items
ai_summary: A lightweight badge component with variant support for semantic states (default, secondary, destructive, outline). Designed to be displayed within horizontal scrolling carousels and card layouts to convey status, categories, or metadata. Uses class-variance-authority for type-safe variant management and integrates seamlessly with shadcn/ui design systems.
